subject: Rust Monster
picture: A classic fantasy rust monster in a metal-strewn dungeon storeroom. Squat armored body like a small armadillo beetle, four thick walking legs, two very long thin antennae touching a pile of simple swords and helmets. A long tail that ends in a flat paddle. Not a cockroach, not a dragon, not a lizard. Stone ceiling, block walls, large floor slabs, closed wooden door. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
